tools.name: listen
tools.description: Turn the Hearing world on or off. "start" begins capturing system audio (or one application) and delivers speech chunks as events; "stop" ends it. Each chunk arrives as an event with a WAV attachment; hand its handle to stt_transcribe when you want the words.

action.description: start = begin listening, stop = end it.

source.description: Overrides the configured source: system audio or one application.

app.description: When source=app: the process name (for example chrome.exe) or a PID. Defaults to the configured application.

minutes.description: Auto-stop after this many minutes; 0 uses the configured value.

summary.zh: 打开或关掉听觉：开始/停止监听系统声音或某个应用的音频。
summary.en: Turn hearing on or off: start/stop listening to system audio or one application.

tools.name: listen_recent
tools.description: List the most recently heard speech chunks: time, duration, source and the attachment handle. Hand a handle to stt_transcribe to get text.

limit.description: How many chunks to list (1-50); default 10.

summary.zh: 看最近听到的语音块及其附件句柄。
summary.en: List the most recently heard speech chunks and their attachment handles.

tools.name: listen_status
tools.description: Hearing status: listening or not, the target, counters, segmentation settings and the last error.

summary.zh: 听觉的状态：是否在听、目标、计数与最近错误。
summary.en: Hearing status: listening, target, counters and the last error.

description.zh: 听到一段语音：正文说明时长与来源，附件是一段 WAV 音频块，可直接交给 stt_transcribe 转写。
description.en: A speech chunk was heard: the text carries duration and source; the attachment is a WAV chunk that can be handed to stt_transcribe.
